subject.title: DX: Add Makefile or justfile for common development tasks

question: Should OpenClaw add a repo-root Makefile, add a justfile, or keep contributor command discovery pnpm-only?
rationale: The source tree can support the wrapper, and an open PR already implements one, but accepting it would make a new supported developer workflow surface that repository policy should choose intentionally.

options.title: Keep pnpm-only for now
options.body: Close this issue and the candidate PR unless a maintainer wants to sponsor the extra command surface.

options.title: Sponsor the Makefile
options.body: Use the open focused Makefile PR as the implementation path and require docs that keep pnpm as the canonical source workflow.

options.title: Choose justfile instead
options.body: Ask for a narrower justfile implementation and close the Makefile-specific candidate PR as the wrong runner choice.

recommendation.title: Keep pnpm-only for now
recommendation.body: Close this issue and the candidate PR unless a maintainer wants to sponsor the extra command surface.

likelyOwner.reason: CONTRIBUTING.md identifies this person as the project-direction owner, and the unresolved choice is product policy rather than code ownership alone.
